intro.heading: Resource Library
intro.sub: Your one-stop-shop for therapy resources — vetted clinical assessment tools, community referrals, and youth and family handouts, all searchable in one place.
intro.pdfNotice: PDF files for each resource are being finalized and will appear here as they're added. Items below show what each resource is and why it's included, even before its file is uploaded.

items.title: Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS)
items.description: A structured interview used to assess the severity and immediacy of suicidal ideation and behavior. Used at intake and re-administered as risk status changes throughout treatment.
items.evidence: A widely adopted, extensively studied risk-assessment instrument used across clinical and research settings for suicide risk stratification.

items.title: Stanley-Brown Safety Planning Intervention
items.description: A brief, collaborative worksheet completed with the client (and caregivers, when appropriate) that identifies warning signs, coping strategies, support contacts, and steps to reduce access to lethal means.
items.evidence: One of the most widely studied and disseminated safety-planning approaches in suicide prevention care.

items.title: DBT Skills: Distress Tolerance & Emotion Regulation
items.description: Skill-building handouts adapted from Dialectical Behavior Therapy to help clients tolerate intense emotions and reduce crisis-driven behavior.
items.evidence: DBT has a substantial evidence base for reducing self-harm and suicidal behavior, including in adolescent populations.

items.title: CBT Cognitive Restructuring Techniques
items.description: Guided worksheets to help clients identify, examine, and reframe unhelpful thought patterns that contribute to distress.
items.evidence: CBT is one of the most extensively researched therapeutic approaches for youth depression and anxiety.

items.title: Behavioral Activation Planning Sheet
items.description: Helps clients schedule small, achievable, values-aligned activities to counter withdrawal and low mood.
items.evidence: Behavioral activation is a well-established, evidence-based component of depression treatment.

items.title: Vetted Mental Health Referrals
items.description: A curated, regularly updated list of community mental health providers for step-down or ongoing care once Rise treatment ends.
items.evidence: Maintained and vetted directly by the Rise and CU Boulder team based on client feedback and provider responsiveness.

items.title: Post-Rise Therapy Options
items.description: A guide to what happens after the Rise treatment window ends, including options by insurance status and geography.
items.evidence: Compiled from partner agency intake criteria and updated as availability changes.

items.title: How to Support Your Teen: A Family Guide
items.description: Plain-language psychoeducation for caregivers on what to expect during treatment and how to support a teen at home.
items.evidence: Grounded in family-inclusive treatment literature; detailed citations to be added.

items.title: Family Engagement Guide
items.description: Suggestions for clinicians on involving caregivers productively in treatment, even in higher-conflict households.
items.evidence: Grounded in family-inclusive treatment literature; detailed citations to be added.

items.title: Youth Coping Skills Worksheet
items.description: A self-guided worksheet helping youth identify and practice personal coping strategies for distress.
items.evidence: Grounded in CBT/DBT coping-skills literature; detailed citations to be added.

items.title: Youth Safety Planning Template
items.description: A youth-facing version of the safety plan, written in accessible language for the client to keep and reference.
items.evidence: Adapted from the Stanley-Brown Safety Planning Intervention for a youth reading level.

items.title: Mindfulness & Grounding Tools
items.description: Brief grounding exercises youth can use independently between sessions to manage acute distress.
items.evidence: Grounded in mindfulness-based intervention literature; detailed citations to be added.

items.title: School Navigation Tip Sheet
items.description: Practical guidance for navigating school partnership complexities, coordinating with counselors, and managing referrals.
items.evidence: Compiled from therapist co-design sessions on real school-coordination challenges.

items.title: District-Specific Info Guides
items.description: Detailed guides for the schools and districts Rise frequently partners with, including key contacts and procedures.
items.evidence: Compiled and maintained directly by the Rise team.

items.title: Multi-System Coordination Guide
items.description: Resources for collaborating across hospitals, clinics, and school teams when a case spans multiple systems.
items.evidence: Compiled from therapist co-design sessions on real multi-system cases.
